faq.answer: Mouthwash is restricted in carry-on luggage. Mouthwash is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Carry-on bottles must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.answer: Yes, Mouthwash is allowed in checked bags. Mouthwash is allowed in checked baggage in any size.
